import re, io
from dotenv import parser as p

def fixed(reader):
    (part,) = reader.read_regex(p._unquoted_value)
    return re.sub(r"\s+#.*", "", part).rstrip()

orig = p.parse_unquoted_value
p.parse_unquoted_value = fixed
for t in ["X=value   \n","Y=word # comment\n","Z=word#nospace\n","W=a\\ #b\n","V= #c\n","U=   \n","T=word\t# c\n",'Q="a # b"   \n',"S='a # b'   \n"]:
    print(repr(t), '->', [(r.key,r.value) for r in p.parse_stream(io.StringIO(t))])
p.parse_unquoted_value = orig
PY

import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream

cases = {
    "X=value   \n": ["value"],
    "Y=word # comment\n": ["word"],
    "X=a   \r\nY=b \t\r\n": ["a", "b"],
    "X=abc#def\n": ["abc#def"],
    "X=  lead   \n": ["lead"],
    "X=\n": [""],
    "X=   \n": [""],
    "X='keep   '\n": ["keep   "],
    'X="keep   "\n': ["keep   "],
    'X="line\\nnext"\n': ["line\nnext"],
    "X='it\\'s'\n": ["it's"],
    "X=value   # trailing\n": ["value"],
    "X=a b\t\t\n": ["a b"],
}
ok = True
for src, exp in cases.items():
    got = [r.value for r in parse_stream(io.StringIO(src))]
    status = "OK " if got == exp else "FAIL"
    if got != exp: ok = False
    print(status, repr(src), "->", got, "expected", exp)
print("ALL PASS" if ok else "MISMATCH")
PY
